'''Kriks''' were creatures that fought each other. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] compared the squabbling [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who existed prior to the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] to kriks.<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>
